title: 第九章 拼刺刀
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“仗是打出来的，不要去学赵括，纸上谈兵。”

校长把蒋羡耘批评了一顿就离开了。

沙盘演练的事一结束，刚刚那种剑拔弩张激烈辩驳的气氛就缓和了下来，大家都是同学，是战友。明面上关系都是不错的。

贺中韩虽不服蒋羡耘，但心底也有些佩服。

回了办公室的校长还看着操场上的这些学员们。

总教官何因钦倒了一杯茶过来：“年轻人气盛，校长不必介怀。”

“我没有介意，永泰那一仗，确实是我打输了。这个蒋羡耘确实是个人才，就是因为他是个人才，不能让他太过得意，必须杀杀他的傲气。”

“我明白了，校长真是用心良苦。

还有个事，也有点意思。”

“哦，什么事？”

“今天那几个学生，大多是湖南的。那个贺中韩，陈亘，还有这个蒋羡耘，都是湖南的。这段时间的表现，还有总试的成绩，这三人皆名列前茅。

还有本届录取的学生中，六百人，有三分之一近两百人都是湖南的。

有不少人还是湖南农讲所出来的，像陈亘，蒋羡耘都是红党的。校长，这军校要都是红党推荐的学员。”

校长也感觉到了事情的严重性，喝了口茶水压压惊：“说明湖南的组织建设的好啊，报考的革命青年比较多，现在的革命方针就是合作，以后这样的话就不要再说了。

湖南负责招生的那个负责人，不仅自己是个人才，还识才啊。

对了，我浙江的学员情况如何？”

何因钦说道：“浙江学员占比也很大，有四五十人。优秀者如胡棕难。对了，校长，刚刚操场上那个叫包国维的学员也是浙江的，年仅十六岁。上海考官给他的批复，博闻强记，过目不忘，是个人才。”

“包国维。”

这是校长第一次对包国维这个名字留下了印象。

主官一般都喜欢手下用自己老家的人，像刘邦的家底都是沛县的，项羽的家底都是江东的。校长自然也喜欢老家的人，喜欢嫡系，致力于培养嫡系。

像浙江的胡棕难，天子门生第一人，以后的西北王。

“蒋羡耘，陈亘，人才，必须要拉过来。”校长是十分爱才的，对自己的嫡系手下也从不吝啬，大方的很。

操场上。

沙盘演练完后，继续体能训练。

攀爬，卧倒匍匐前进。俯卧撑，摔跤，刺杀格斗，大刀刀法，通通来了一遍。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Wars are fought, don't imitate Zhao Kuo and talk about war on paper."

The principal criticized Jiang Xianyun and left.

As soon as the sand table exercise ended, the tense and fierce argument calmed down. We are all classmates and comrades-in-arms.On the surface, the relationship is good.

Although He Zhonghan was not convinced by Jiang Xianyun, he also admired him in his heart.

The principal who returned to the office was still looking at the students on the playground.

Chief Instructor He Yinqin poured a cup of tea over and said, "Young people are very energetic. Principal, don't worry about it."

"I didn't mind. I did lose the Yongtai battle. This Jiang Xianyun is indeed a talent, just because he is a talent, we can't let him get too proud, and we must kill his arrogance."

"I understand, the principal has really good intentions.

There is another thing, which is also interesting."

"Oh, what's the matter?"

"Most of the students today are from Hunan. That He Zhonghan, Chen Gen, and this Jiang Xianyun are all from Hunan. Their performance during this period, as well as their overall examination results, all three of them ranked among the best.

Among the 600 students admitted this year, one-third and nearly 200 are from Hunan.

Many people came from the Hunan Agricultural Lecture School, like Chen Gen and Jiang Xianyun, both of whom were members of the Red Party.Principal, all students in this military academy must be recommended by the Red Party."

The principal also felt the seriousness of the matter and took a sip of tea to calm down: "It shows that Hunan's organizational construction is good. There are more revolutionary young people applying for the exam. The current revolutionary policy is cooperation. Don't say such words again in the future.

The person in charge of admissions in Hunan is not only a talented person, but also a talented person.

By the way, how are the students in Zhejiang?"

He Yinqin said: "Zhejiang students also account for a large proportion, forty or fifty people. Excellent people are like Hu Zong. By the way, principal, the student named Bao Guowei on the playground just now is also from Zhejiang. He is only sixteen years old. The Shanghai examiner gave him the approval, and he has a strong memory and a photographic memory. He is a talent."

"Bao Guowei."

This was the first time the principal was impressed by the name Bao Guowei.

Chief officials generally like to use people from their own hometown as subordinates. For example, Liu Bang's family background is from Peixian County, and Xiang Yu's family background is from Jiangdong.The principal naturally also likes people from his hometown and direct descendants, and is committed to cultivating direct descendants.

Like Hu Zongnan of Zhejiang, the first disciple of the Emperor and the future King of the Northwest.

"Jiang Xianyun, Chen Gen, talents must be brought over." The principal loves talents very much, and he is never stingy and generous to his direct subordinates.

On the playground.

After the sand table drill, continue physical training.

Climb, lie down and crawl forward.Push-ups, wrestling, assassination fighting, machete skills, all done again.
